title: How Reiner Achieved a 100% Win Rate Selling Short Strangles
summary: Reiner Hoffmann sells gated short strangles on RUT (10-delta put / 8-delta call, 30 DTE, 50% profit target), entering only when IV is elevated and the vol term structure is in contango, and claims a 100% win rate over ~3 years (~75 trades) defended by a delta-35 watch trigger, a 20%-of-margin hard stop, micro-future tail hedges, and conservative ~10% sizing. The 100% headline is statistically vacuous on an undefined-risk seller in a benign window and his own +10% gap near-miss shows the tail is real. Write-up: strategies/short_strangle_reiner.md (conviction 2/5).
